name: UP Police Constable
fullName: Uttar Pradesh Police Constable Recruitment (Civil Police, PAC, SSF, Jail Warder)
conductingBody: Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB)
approxCandidates: ≈48 lakh applied in 2024 (60,244 posts); ≈32–33 lakh applicants reported for the 2025–26 drive (32,679 posts)
eligibility: Class 12 (Intermediate) pass; age limits vary by gender and category (age relaxation announced for the 2025–26 drive) – check the official notice

notification.summary: Advt. PRPB-B 07/2025 for 32,679 posts (Constable Civil Police, PAC, SSF and Jail Warder) was notified on 31 Dec 2025. The written exam was held on 8–10 June 2026 and the written result was declared on 31 July 2026 with 76,184 candidates shortlisted for DV/PST; physical tests are under way. Dates for DV/PST/PET were taken from news reports – confirm on uppbpb.gov.in.

pattern.notes: Bilingual paper (Hindi/English). Each section has a qualifying minimum of 35% (general) in the written exam as per recent notices. The written exam is followed by DV, PST, PET (4.8 km run) and medical. Section-wise counts follow the 2024 and 2026 papers (approximately 37–38 per section).

trendAnalysis.summary: Analysis of the 2018–19 paper, the Aug-2024 re-exam and the June-2026 exam. The paper is moderate overall: General Hindi and Numerical Ability are scoring, while GK is the deciding section, with a heavy UP-specific component (districts, rivers, national parks, schemes) and current affairs from the preceding 12 months. Reasoning has shifted towards verbal reasoning plus 'mental aptitude' questions on police duties, public interest and the law-and-order situation. Arithmetic stays at Class 10 level, with percentage, profit-loss, interest, time-work and speed being the high-yield topics. Negative marking (−0.5) has made accuracy more important since 2024.

topics.topic: One-word Substitution (वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द)

resources.notes: UPPRPB publishes provisional and final answer keys (with series-wise question booklets for objection) on uppbpb.gov.in shortly after each written exam; they are removed after the objection window, so previous papers are usually found via coaching compilations. No official mock test is provided.

questions.question: Who founded the Indian National Congress in 1885?
questions.questionHi: 1885 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस की स्थापना किसने की थी?
questions.explanation: Allan Octavian Hume, a retired British civil servant, founded the INC in 1885; W. C. Bonnerjee presided over its first session in Bombay.

questions.question: In which year was the Battle of Plassey fought?
questions.questionHi: प्लासी का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Plassey (23 June 1757) was fought between Robert Clive and Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah. 1764 is Buxar, 1761 is the Third Battle of Panipat.

questions.question: The Chauri Chaura incident of 1922, after which Gandhiji withdrew the Non-Cooperation Movement, took place in which present-day district of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.questionHi: 1922 की चौरी-चौरा घटना, जिसके बाद गांधीजी ने असहयोग आंदोलन वापस लिया, वर्तमान उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में हुई थी?
questions.explanation: Chauri Chaura is in Gorakhpur district. The burning of the police station there on 5 February 1922 led Gandhiji to call off the movement.

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability?
questions.questionHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद अस्पृश्यता का उन्मूलन करता है?
questions.explanation: Article 17 abolishes untouchability. Article 14 is equality before law, 21 is right to life and 32 is constitutional remedies.

questions.question: What is the minimum age required to become a member of the Lok Sabha?
questions.questionHi: लोकसभा का सदस्य बनने के लिए न्यूनतम आयु कितनी है?
questions.explanation: Article 84 fixes 25 years for the Lok Sabha (30 years for the Rajya Sabha).

questions.question: Which river is popularly known as the 'Dakshin Ganga'?
questions.questionHi: किस नदी को 'दक्षिण गंगा' के नाम से जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation: The Godavari, the longest river of peninsular India, is called the Dakshin Ganga (Ganga of the South).

questions.question: Which city of Uttar Pradesh is famous worldwide as the 'Carpet City' of India?
questions.questionHi: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा शहर भारत की 'कालीन नगरी' के रूप में विश्व-प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: Bhadohi is the hub of hand-knotted carpets. Firozabad is known for glass bangles, Moradabad for brassware and Aligarh for locks.

questions.question: Dudhwa National Park is located in which district of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.questionHi: दुधवा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: Dudhwa National Park lies in Lakhimpur Kheri district on the Indo-Nepal border. Bahraich has Katarniaghat and Pilibhit has a separate tiger reserve.

questions.question: The historic Kalinjar Fort is situated in which district of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.questionHi: ऐतिहासिक कालिंजर किला उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: Kalinjar Fort stands in Banda district in the Bundelkhand region.

questions.question: Which institution decides the repo rate in India?
questions.questionHi: भारत में रेपो दर का निर्धारण कौन-सी संस्था करती है?
questions.explanation: The repo rate is set by the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of baking soda?
questions.questionHi: खाने के सोडे (बेकिंग सोडा) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
questions.explanation: Baking soda is sodium hydrogen carbonate, NaHCO₃. Na₂CO₃ is washing soda and CaCO₃ is limestone.

questions.question: Deficiency of Vitamin C causes which disease?
questions.questionHi: विटामिन C की कमी से कौन-सा रोग होता है?
questions.explanation: Vitamin C deficiency causes scurvy. Rickets is due to Vitamin D, night blindness to Vitamin A and beriberi to Vitamin B1.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of force?
questions.questionHi: बल का SI मात्रक क्या है?
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons (kg·m/s²). Joule is the unit of work, watt of power and pascal of pressure.

questions.question: The Maha Kumbh Mela of 2025 was organised in which city?
questions.questionHi: वर्ष 2025 का महाकुंभ मेला किस शहर में आयोजित किया गया था?
questions.explanation: The Maha Kumbh 2025 (13 Jan – 26 Feb 2025) was held at the Triveni Sangam in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh.

questions.question: Which of the following is an input device of a computer?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कंप्यूटर का इनपुट डिवाइस है?
questions.explanation: A keyboard sends data into the computer; monitor, printer and speaker are output devices.

questions.question: Choose the synonym (पर्यायवाची) of 'अग्नि'.
questions.questionHi: 'अग्नि' का पर्यायवाची शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: अनल = अग्नि। अनिल = हवा, नीर = जल, अंबर = आकाश।

questions.question: Choose the synonym (पर्यायवाची) of 'कमल'.
questions.questionHi: 'कमल' का पर्यायवाची शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: पंकज (कीचड़ में जन्मा) = कमल। जलद और नीरद = बादल, पावक = आग।

questions.question: Choose the antonym (विलोम) of 'उत्थान'.
questions.questionHi: 'उत्थान' का विलोम शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: उत्थान (ऊपर उठना) का विलोम पतन है; अन्य तीनों उत्थान के समानार्थी हैं।

questions.question: Choose the antonym (विलोम) of 'मौखिक'.
questions.questionHi: 'मौखिक' का विलोम शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: मौखिक (मुख से कहा गया) का विलोम लिखित है।

questions.question: What is the correct sandhi-vichchhed (संधि-विच्छेद) of 'विद्यालय'?
questions.questionHi: 'विद्यालय' का सही संधि-विच्छेद क्या है?
questions.explanation: विद्या + आलय: आ + आ = आ (दीर्घ संधि) → विद्यालय।

questions.question: 'सूर्योदय' (सूर्य + उदय) में कौन-सी संधि है? (Which sandhi is in 'सूर्योदय'?)
questions.questionHi: 'सूर्योदय' (सूर्य + उदय) में कौन-सी संधि है?
questions.explanation: अ + उ = ओ होता है, जो गुण संधि का नियम है।

questions.question: Which samas (समास) is used in 'चौराहा'?
questions.questionHi: 'चौराहा' में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation: चौराहा = चार राहों का समाहार; पहला पद संख्यावाचक है, अतः द्विगु समास।

questions.question: Which samas (समास) is used in 'यथाशक्ति'?
questions.questionHi: 'यथाशक्ति' में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation: यथाशक्ति = शक्ति के अनुसार; पहला पद 'यथा' अव्यय है और पूरा पद अव्यय की तरह प्रयुक्त होता है, अतः अव्ययीभाव समास।

questions.question: What is the meaning of the idiom 'नौ दो ग्यारह होना'?
questions.questionHi: मुहावरे 'नौ दो ग्यारह होना' का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'नौ दो ग्यारह होना' का अर्थ है चुपचाप भाग जाना। उदाहरण: पुलिस को देखते ही चोर नौ दो ग्यारह हो गया।

questions.question: What is the meaning of the proverb 'अधजल गगरी छलकत जाय'?
options: अधूरा काम सदा हानि करता है
कम ज्ञान वाला अधिक दिखावा करता है
questions.questionHi: लोकोक्ति 'अधजल गगरी छलकत जाय' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionsHi: अधूरा काम सदा हानि करता है
कम ज्ञान वाला अधिक दिखावा करता है
questions.explanation: आधी भरी गगरी छलकती है, वैसे ही अल्पज्ञ व्यक्ति अपने थोड़े ज्ञान का अधिक प्रदर्शन करता है।

questions.topic: One-word Substitution (वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द)
questions.question: One word for 'जिसका कोई शत्रु न जन्मा हो':
questions.questionHi: 'जिसका कोई शत्रु न जन्मा हो' के लिए एक शब्द:
questions.explanation: अजातशत्रु = जिसका कोई शत्रु पैदा ही न हुआ हो। अजेय = जिसे जीता न जा सके, शत्रुघ्न = शत्रु का नाश करने वाला।

questions.question: Which is the tadbhav (तद्भव) form of the tatsam word 'सूर्य'?
questions.questionHi: तत्सम शब्द 'सूर्य' का तद्भव रूप कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: सूर्य → सूरज (तद्भव)। रवि, दिनकर, भानु सूर्य के तत्सम पर्यायवाची हैं।

questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word (शुद्ध वर्तनी).
questions.questionHi: शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: शुद्ध रूप 'उज्ज्वल' है (उद् + ज्वल → उज्ज्वल), जिसमें 'ज्' के बाद 'ज्व' आता है।

questions.question: Who wrote the novel 'गोदान'?
questions.questionHi: 'गोदान' उपन्यास के लेखक कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: 'गोदान' (1936) मुंशी प्रेमचंद का अंतिम पूर्ण उपन्यास है।

questions.question: What is the sthayi bhav (स्थायी भाव) of Veer Ras (वीर रस)?
questions.questionHi: वीर रस का स्थायी भाव क्या है?
questions.explanation: वीर रस का स्थायी भाव उत्साह है। क्रोध रौद्र रस का, रति श्रृंगार का और शोक करुण रस का स्थायी भाव है।

questions.question: A number is first increased by 20% and then the result is decreased by 20%. What is the net change?
questions.questionHi: किसी संख्या में पहले 20% की वृद्धि की जाती है और फिर परिणाम में 20% की कमी की जाती है। कुल परिवर्तन कितना है?
questions.explanation: 100 → 120 → 120 × 0.8 = 96, so there is a net decrease of 4%.

questions.question: An article bought for ₹400 is sold for ₹460. What is the profit percentage?
questions.questionHi: ₹400 में खरीदी गई एक वस्तु ₹460 में बेची जाती है। लाभ प्रतिशत कितना है?

questions.question: What is the simple interest on ₹5,000 at 8% per annum for 3 years?
questions.questionHi: ₹5,000 पर 8% वार्षिक दर से 3 वर्ष का साधारण ब्याज कितना होगा?

questions.question: What is the compound interest on ₹10,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually?
questions.questionHi: ₹10,000 पर 10% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्ष का चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (वार्षिक संयोजन) कितना होगा?

questions.question: ₹1,800 is divided between two persons in the ratio 4 : 5. What is the larger share?
questions.questionHi: ₹1,800 को दो व्यक्तियों में 4 : 5 के अनुपात में बाँटा जाता है। बड़ा हिस्सा कितना है?
questions.explanation: Total parts = 9; one part = 1800/9 = ₹200; larger share = 5 × 200 = ₹1,000.

questions.question: What is the average of the first 10 natural numbers?
questions.questionHi: प्रथम 10 प्राकृत संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?

questions.question: The average of 5 numbers is 24. If one number is removed, the average of the remaining numbers becomes 22. Which number was removed?
questions.questionHi: 5 संख्याओं का औसत 24 है। एक संख्या हटाने पर शेष संख्याओं का औसत 22 हो जाता है। हटाई गई संख्या कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: Total of 5 numbers = 120; total of 4 numbers = 88; removed number = 120 − 88 = 32.

questions.question: A can finish a work in 12 days and B in 18 days. In how many days can they finish it working together?
questions.questionHi: A किसी काम को 12 दिनों में और B 18 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। दोनों मिलकर उसे कितने दिनों में पूरा करेंगे?
questions.explanation: Combined work per day = 1/12 + 1/18 = 3/36 + 2/36 = 5/36; time = 36/5 = 7.2 days.

questions.question: A speed of 72 km/h is equal to how many metres per second?
questions.questionHi: 72 किमी/घंटा की चाल कितने मीटर/सेकंड के बराबर है?

questions.question: A train 150 m long is running at 54 km/h. How long will it take to cross a signal pole?
questions.questionHi: 150 मीटर लंबी एक ट्रेन 54 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चल रही है। वह एक सिग्नल खंभे को कितने समय में पार करेगी?
questions.explanation: 54 km/h = 15 m/s; time = 150 / 15 = 10 seconds.

questions.question: What is the area of a circle of radius 7 cm? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.questionHi: 7 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल क्या है? (π = 22/7 लें)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 154 cm². (44 cm is the circumference.)

questions.question: What is the LCM of 12, 18 and 30?
questions.questionHi: 12, 18 और 30 का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) क्या है?

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 11?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी संख्या 11 से विभाज्य है?
questions.explanation: Test for 11: alternate digit sum difference. 2849 → (2+4) − (8+9) = −11, divisible (2849 = 11 × 259). The others give −2, −12 and −9.

questions.question: Simplify: 25 × 4 ÷ 5 + 6 − 3
A father is three times as old as his son. After 10 years, he will be twice as old as his son. What is the father's present age?
questions.questionHi: पिता की आयु पुत्र की आयु की तीन गुनी है। 10 वर्ष बाद पिता की आयु पुत्र की आयु की दोगुनी हो जाएगी। पिता की वर्तमान आयु कितनी है?
questions.explanation: Let the son be x. 3x + 10 = 2(x + 10) ⇒ x = 10, so the father is 30 years old.

questions.question: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
questions.questionHi: डॉक्टर : अस्पताल :: शिक्षक : ?
questions.explanation: A doctor works in a hospital; a teacher works in a school.

questions.question: Find the odd one out.
questions.questionHi: विषम को चुनिए।
questions.explanation: Lion, tiger and leopard are carnivorous big cats; the cow is a herbivore.

questions.question: Find the odd number out.
questions.questionHi: विषम संख्या चुनिए।
questions.explanation: 17, 19 and 23 are prime numbers; 27 = 3 × 9 is not.

questions.question: Find the next number: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: Differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, so the next difference is 12: 30 + 12 = 42. (Each term is n(n+1).)

questions.question: Find the next letter: A, C, F, J, O, ?
questions.questionHi: अगला अक्षर ज्ञात कीजिए: A, C, F, J, O, ?
questions.explanation: Positions 1, 3, 6, 10, 15 increase by 2, 3, 4, 5; next is 15 + 6 = 21 = U.

questions.question: If POLICE is coded as QPMJDF, how will THANA be coded?
questions.questionHi: यदि POLICE को QPMJDF लिखा जाता है, तो THANA को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.explanation: Each letter is moved one place forward: T→U, H→I, A→B, N→O, A→B, giving UIBOB.

questions.question: If CAT = 24 (sum of the alphabet positions of its letters), what is DOG?
questions.questionHi: यदि CAT = 24 (अक्षरों के वर्णमाला क्रमांकों का योग), तो DOG = ?

questions.question: Pointing to a man, Rita says, "He is the son of my paternal grandfather's only son." How is the man related to Rita?
questions.questionHi: एक व्यक्ति की ओर इशारा करते हुए रीता कहती है, "वह मेरे दादा के इकलौते पुत्र का पुत्र है।" वह व्यक्ति रीता का क्या लगता है?
questions.explanation: Rita's (paternal) grandfather's only son is Rita's father. The father's son is Rita's brother.

questions.question: A is the sister of B. C is the mother of B. D is the father of C. How is A related to D?
questions.questionHi: A, B की बहन है। C, B की माता है। D, C का पिता है। A का D से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: A and B are children of C, and D is C's father. So A (a female) is D's granddaughter.

questions.question: Ram walks 5 km north, turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right again and walks 5 km. Where is he now with respect to his starting point?
questions.questionHi: राम 5 किमी उत्तर चलता है, दाएँ मुड़कर 3 किमी चलता है, फिर दोबारा दाएँ मुड़कर 5 किमी चलता है। वह अपने आरंभिक बिंदु से कहाँ है?
questions.explanation: North 5 km, then right (east) 3 km, then right (south) 5 km. The north and south walks cancel, leaving him 3 km east of the start.

questions.question: In a row of 40 students, Mohan is 15th from the left end. What is his position from the right end?
questions.questionHi: 40 छात्रों की एक पंक्ति में मोहन बाएँ छोर से 15वें स्थान पर है। दाएँ छोर से उसका स्थान क्या है?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 40 − 15 + 1 = 26.

questions.question: If 1 January 2025 was a Wednesday, what day of the week was 1 January 2026?
questions.questionHi: यदि 1 जनवरी 2025 को बुधवार था, तो 1 जनवरी 2026 को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: 2025 is not a leap year (365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day), so the day moves forward by one: Thursday.

questions.question: Statements: All constables are policemen. Some policemen are officers. Conclusions: I. Some policemen are constables. II. Some constables are officers. Which conclusion(s) follow?
questions.questionHi: कथन: सभी कांस्टेबल पुलिसकर्मी हैं। कुछ पुलिसकर्मी अधिकारी हैं। निष्कर्ष: I. कुछ पुलिसकर्मी कांस्टेबल हैं। II. कुछ कांस्टेबल अधिकारी हैं। कौन-सा/से निष्कर्ष अनुसरण करता/करते है/हैं?
optionsHi: न तो I और न ही II
questions.explanation: 'All constables are policemen' converts to 'Some policemen are constables', so I follows. The officers may lie outside the constable group, so II does not necessarily follow.

questions.question: While on patrol, a constable finds a lost child crying in a crowded market. What is the most appropriate action?
options: Leave the child with a nearby shopkeeper and continue patrolling
Ignore the matter because no crime has been committed
Hand the child to the first person who claims to know him
Keep the child safe, comfort him and try to trace the guardians while informing the control room
questions.questionHi: गश्त के दौरान एक कांस्टेबल को भीड़ भरे बाज़ार में एक खोया हुआ बच्चा रोता हुआ मिलता है। सबसे उचित कार्य क्या है?
optionsHi: बच्चे को पास के दुकानदार के पास छोड़कर गश्त जारी रखना
कोई अपराध नहीं हुआ है, इसलिए मामले को अनदेखा करना
बच्चे को पहचानने का दावा करने वाले पहले व्यक्ति को सौंप देना
बच्चे को सुरक्षित रखकर ढाढ़स बँधाना और कंट्रोल रूम को सूचित करते हुए अभिभावकों की तलाश करना
questions.explanation: A police officer must ensure the child's safety and reunite the child with verified guardians, using announcements and the control room. The other actions put the child at risk.
